detail: prose topic rejected: ST title 'Response Time Utility' does not match the topic title 'Response Time Utility <BOOK>' [run 'Response Time Utility The TPNS Response Time Utility provides response time statistics and graphs for selected terminals or the entire simulated network after the simulation is finished.It provides you with a great deal of flexibility in defining the beginning and end of logical transactions, so that you can measure particular responses or track system response statistics over time.Refer to "Using the Response Time Utility" and to TPNS General Utilities for more information about the Response Time Utility.']
